formulas.chanceWithFields: baseChance-.0925*timeAccelerationFieldMetadata+.05*stabilisationFieldMetadata - overflow penalties, clamp see source; pity mechanic may improve subsequent attempts
formulas.parallelRawStarMatterInput: P>1: HeBase*(12.4/1000000f)*P litres replaces H/He; Java float rounding
formulas.parallelEnergy: powerMultiplier=max(1,2.3^parallelExponent); consumedEU=baseUsedEU*powerMultiplier*1.63/POWER_DIVISION_CONSTANT with Java casts; outputEU also power scaled
formulas.itemOutputs: validDustGenerator(process planet normal/small ore yields), merge 3*sumOfItems of planet stone dust, ItemStackLong carries actual counts; displayed GTRecipe item stack sizes lose true counts

notes: Machine empties ALL stored H and He on P1 start; input minimum is not a cap. At P>1 empties all stored Raw Star Matter. Extra fluid introduces failure penalties.
Planet display token is a non-consumed selector; do not require crafting synthetic gtneioreplugin display blocks.
Astral Arrays are inserted and removed from inventory into persistent machine astralArrayAmount; they are setup investment, not ordinary per recipe consumables.
Numerical item outputs and plasma fuel energy map require runtime special EyeOfHarmonyRecipe object or recreation of planet ore-generation; corpus does not preserve them.
Do not claim complete quantitative EOH BOM until true long item outputs and startup energy are reconstructed.

verifiedSolidOutputs.quantityInterpretation: Base coproduct count from processDD before run success, yield, parallel and machine field modifiers; N is a runtime registry cardinality, not a fabricated constant.

verifiedSolidOutputConditions: N = validMaterialSet.size() en specialDeepDarkRecipe: unión sin duplicados de Materials con ore u oreSmall no null y los bridge Materials de Werkstoff soportados por BWOreAdapter para Stone (normal o small). El conjunto GT++ se procesa adicionalmente pero NO se suma al denominador N.

Deep Dark admite todos esos materiales registrados aunque no haya vena natural. Los tres definen addOreItems(); el export RC2 confirma sus tres polvos en la salida DD. No se requiere adquirir un bloque de mena.
timeCalculator(10) = (long)(18000 * GTUtility.powInt(1.4,10)). processDD usa intencionalmente tier 10 para cantidad, aunque el proceso DD tiene rocketTier=9 y tiempo timeCalculator(9).

Cada uno tiene mOreMultiplier=1 y mDirectSmelting=this. DarkIron tiene subproducto Iron; Forcicium y Forcillium tienen Thorium/Neodymium/RareEarth. processHelper no añade subproductos del mismo material para estas tres definiciones.
Los tres polvos son coproductos de la MISMA ejecución eoh:74987; conservar sus fluidos y requerimientos originales, sin triplicar el proceso.
